summary:
Verdict: partial, contact code. This run judged the merged tree at HEAD 4092c13, the two-parent merge of e116d2d (SL-049) and 1922131 (uat). That is what the stale take-back asked for.

**What changed since the last tree validated (91dfe9c)**
- Only three files: .taad/fitness.yaml, tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 and tests/rules/SettledCountProbe.ps1.
- No C# changed, nothing under src/ changed since base 0647ead, and no conflict markers remain.

**How the two slices' work holds together (all run here)**
- **Build:** a full --no-incremental build with the repo-local SDK gave 0 warnings and 0 errors, and every assembly was rewritten.
- **Default suite:** 332 passed, 0 failed, 0 not executed. The trx has no CloudPlaceholderTests or StalledShareTests definitions.
- **Fitness op=check:** all 51 rules hold, including SL-053's new rule and SL-049's widened rules.
- **rules-parity:** AGREE with 36 settled entries under both pwsh and powershell.exe.
- **RuleCases C-001 to C-005:** all held. C-001 and C-003 failed at 91dfe9c on the stale '28 settled' pin, and SL-053's derived count fixes that.
- **SettledCountProbe -Shape All:** held.
- **Opt-in filter:** it lists exactly the 4 CloudPlaceholderTests Facts.
- **The two gated Facts that register nothing:** both passed ('ERR CfRegisterSyncRoot hr=0x80070002', exit 2; silent provider killed at 2 s). Each wrote the 'teardown shape: none pending' line.
- **Baked default filter:** the assembly holds 'Network!=TEST-NET-1&Network!=SMB-LOOPBACK&Cloud!=CF-SYNC-ROOT'.
- **Leftovers:** %TEMP% had 0 fsa-cf-* folders before and after.

**Not reached: the slice's central claim, in the repo's own build.** The claim is that the shipped Scanner and SynchronousIoCancel get freed from a real cldflt stall, and that placeholders are sized without being downloaded. Criteria 1, 4, 6, 8, 9 and 10, and Derived 3, are therefore not checked. Their only real contact is SL-049's own risk spike, run on a scratch copy of the tree.
- I did not run `--filter Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT` because it registers a real cldflt sync root under %TEMP%.
- Design open question 1 (may that happen on this PC) is still open in index.json.
- The brief's answered-questions list is cut off at Q-016, and the tree has no questions file, so I cannot rule out an answer recorded after that point. I found none.
- No administrator rights are involved, so no elevation operation applies.

**This is a loop.** Validate has now returned the same partial five times (attempts 1 to 5) for the same reason. The builds in between changed no src: build 2 was review fixes and build 3 was a merge. Only a person's answer to open question 1 changes the outcome.
- If the answer is yes, the next validate should run the opt-in filter three times in a row and read each 'teardown shape:' line.
- If the answer is no, the slice should be accepted as partial, or re-scoped at design, with Derived 3 recorded as reached only by the spike.

I raised no obligation, because sending the slice back to any stage would only add another lap.

criteria.criterion: 1. Cancel a scan stalled on a cloud folder: 'stall' (flags NONE, FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS never answered), cancelled 3 s in, with 'ok' (3 files) listed before it
criteria.how: StalledFetchIsFreedByCancelThroughTheShippedGuard is built and the opt-in filter selects it, but it was not run. It registers a real sync root, and open question 1 has no answer. The only real contact is spike 1 (conditional: freed in 32 ms, on a scratch copy of the tree).

criteria.criterion: 2. Match provider callbacks to the scan: callback lines from a pid other than testhost on the same root
criteria.how: CloudRigTests.OnlyThisProcesssCallbacksCountAsTheScans passed in this run's default suite (332/332). The callback lines are synthetic, so this is code contact.

criteria.criterion: 3. Cancel does not free the scan: still running 5 s after cts.Cancel() because the guard regressed
criteria.how: CloudRigTests.AScanCancelDoesNotFreeIsFreedByForceAndFails passed in this run. It uses an uninterruptible stand-in block, not a real cldflt stall.

criteria.criterion: 4. Report a cancelled stalled folder: 'stall' after a Cancelled scan
criteria.how: This is asserted only inside the unrun stall Fact ('stall' is an empty Folder and is not in Unreadable). Spike 1 measured it outside the repo build. Design open question 2, whether this is acceptable, is also unanswered.

criteria.criterion: 5. Start the provider: it prints ERR and exits 2, or stays silent for 30 s without READY
criteria.how: Both AProviderThatCannotStart Facts passed in this run: 'ERR CfRegisterSyncRoot hr=0x80070002', exit 2 in 103 ms, and the silent provider killed at 2 s with no READY. A missing folder stands in for a non-NTFS %TEMP% or a missing cldflt.

criteria.criterion: 6. Tear down after a killed provider: killed while 'stall' is unpopulated with FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS pending, then the Fact re-run three times in a row
criteria.how: That shape only arises in the unrun stall Fact, and the three runs in a row were not done. Only the 'teardown shape: none pending' branch executed here, on the two non-registering Facts. The PENDING branch has never run.

criteria.criterion: 7. Sweep stale sync roots: a leftover fsa-cf root from a dead testhost, next to look-alike names
criteria.how: TheSweepRemovesOnlyTheRootOfARunThatIsGone, junction case included, passed in this run. The unregister is injected, so the real CfUnregisterSyncRoot was not exercised against a registered stale root.

criteria.criterion: 8. Size dehydrated cloud placeholders (5 MiB, 12345 B, 3 MiB nested under a/sub, population disabled)
criteria.how: DehydratedPlaceholdersAreTraversedWithTrueSizesAndNeverHydrated registers a sync root, so it was not run. The only real contact is spike 2 (go).

criteria.criterion: 9. Count a hardlink among placeholders (b/f4-link.bin, HardLink ALLOWED)
criteria.how: This is in the unrun tree Fact's UNMEASURED section. No spike measured it (critique m6).

criteria.criterion: 10. Hydration regression: FETCH_DATA from the testhost pid, or a placeholder losing RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS
criteria.how: This is in the unrun tree Fact. The only real contact is spike 3 (go: 0 FETCH_DATA over 9 scans, in a scratch build).

criteria.criterion: 11. Run the default suite: dotnet test with no --filter
criteria.how: This run, on the merged tree: 332 passed, 0 failed. The trx has no CloudPlaceholderTests or StalledShareTests definitions.

criteria.criterion: 12. Guard against a Trait missing from the default filter
criteria.how: The 10 OptInTraitTests passed in this run. The rebuilt assembly bakes 'Network!=TEST-NET-1&Network!=SMB-LOOPBACK&Cloud!=CF-SYNC-ROOT' as DefaultTestFilter from FsaDefaultTestFilter.

criteria.criterion: 13. Partial hydration arm (1 MiB of 8 MiB): excluded by the design
criteria.how: The opt-in filter lists only the 4 CloudPlaceholderTests Facts, and none of them hydrates part of a file.

criteria.criterion: 14. Stall without cancel until a timeout: excluded by the design
criteria.how: The only stall Fact always cancels. The tree Fact's 30 s CancelAfter is a bound, not an assertion about a stall.

criteria.criterion: Derived 1: the harness is tracked in the repository, not only as scratch in %TEMP%
criteria.how: git ls-files lists tests/CfProvider/{CfProvider.csproj,Program.cs} and Core.Tests' CloudPlaceholderTests.cs, CloudRig.cs and ScanDeadline.cs. CfProvider is in FsAnalyser.slnx and builds with it.

criteria.criterion: Derived 2: the harness exists as an xunit test in tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests
criteria.how: CloudPlaceholderTests has 4 Facts, which --list-tests under the opt-in filter shows. Two of them ran and passed here.

criteria.criterion: Derived 3: the test drives the shipped Scanner.Scan and SynchronousIoCancel on a real cf-filter folder
criteria.how: CloudPlaceholderTests.cs:374-381 calls the shipped Scanner.Scan through the SynchronousIoCancel.Created seam, via the ProjectReference to src. It has never run on a real cf-filter folder in the repo's build, because of open question 1.

criteria.criterion: Derived 4: opt-in by a Trait and the project's default filter, not by Skip
criteria.how: [Trait("Cloud","CF-SYNC-ROOT")] at CloudPlaceholderTests.cs:38, the csproj default filter clause, and no Skip or Explicit anywhere. The default run executed 0 gated tests.

criteria.criterion: Derived 5 (premise): a separate-process provider with sync-root flag 2 runs unelevated
criteria.how: In this build the provider ran unelevated only on paths that register nothing. Unelevated registration is measured only by SL-049's spikes and SL-024's respike.

obligations.evidence: Both AProviderThatCannotStart Facts passed on the merged tree: ERR hr=0x80070002 with exit 2, and a silent provider killed with no READY.
Default run on the merged tree: 332 passed, and the trx has no CloudPlaceholderTests definitions.
The OptInTraitTests Theory and EveryOptInTraitIsExcludedByTheDefaultFilter passed in this run.
The csproj separates FsaDefaultTestFilter from VSTestTestCaseFilter (lines 13, 14, 18), and the rebuilt assembly holds the full default string.

The 'teardown shape: none pending' line was produced on both non-registering Facts. The PENDING branch and the stall Fact's held listing have never executed, because the stall Fact is unrun (open question 1).
TheSweepRemovesOnlyTheRootOfARunThatIsGone, junction case included, passed this run. validate-slice-2 killed the mutant at 91dfe9c, and those files are unchanged since.

not_reached: The stall Fact on a real cldflt sync root in the repo's own build: whether the shipped SynchronousIoCancel frees a scan blocked on an unanswered FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS (criteria 1 and 4, Derived 3). Not run because design open question 1 has no answer on record. It needs a person's decision, not an administrator.
The tree Fact on a real sync root: true sizes, 0 bytes on disk, zero FETCH_DATA from the testhost, and RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS intact after the scan (criteria 8 and 10).
The hardlink-among-placeholders assertions (criterion 9). No spike and no repo run has measured them.
Teardown after a killed provider, three runs in a row on real roots (criterion 6). The 'teardown shape: PENDING' line has never been produced.
Unelevated registration by the repo's own CfProvider (Derived 5).
The sweep's real CfUnregisterSyncRoot plus recursive delete against a genuinely stale registered root. The default tests inject the unregister.

Cross-engine agreement from eng/rules-harness/harness.py (RuleCases C-006 to C-014) on the merged yaml's InteropLivesOnlyInNative exemptions and SL-049 patterns. It needs the TAAD engine's interpreter and checkout.
Whether open question 1 was answered after Q-016. The brief cuts the answered list off there, so 'no answer found' is weaker evidence than it sounds.
A late-answering or error-replying provider, and a kill freeing a scan blocked on a pending FETCH_DATA. No stage measured either.
